i.norm: Tests {@link ByteUtils#fromLittleEndian(byte[], int, int)}, which reads a slice of a byte array as a little-endian (least-significant byte first) long.
Read 3 bytes starting at index 1, i.e. the slice { 2, 3, 4 }. Little-endian means the first byte is the lowest-order one: 2 * 256^0 + 3 * 256^1 + 4 * 256^2.
